rationale: Frozen learner target SHA256 exactly matches assignment.artifactHashes.layout. Full learner copy, 18 per-interaction choice/hint views, figure descriptions and oldCompleteResume were inspected before new author rationale. Reviewer B authored only the independent probe script, not lesson copy or proposed patch; prior exposure is disclosed and this is not blind review.

Blocking static defect: scoped text-align:left targets the outer formula container. Existing .reading-formula-expression is display:flex with justify-content:center; N13 is absent from enabledUnits and follows this non-typeset branch. Text alignment does not change flex main-axis alignment. At <=350px existing Q05 grid also sets justify-content:center and justify-items:center. Thus same-derivation left-edge alignment promised by P001 is not implemented by the four-file target.

Explicit row projection maps all 60 N13 physical blocks to 60 compiled nodes; original 12 IDs, 48 choice strings, answers, acceptedAnswers and answerTypes are preserved. Q04/Q07/Q09 add six separate decisions, yielding 18. Term usage ordinary is deliberately removed by the mechanical projection and is not treated as display loss.

Equation-number mapping chooses nine end rows, all formula blocks; proposed Page passes the exact revision-gated map to the existing TextbookFormula equationNumber prop. This resolves the earlier metadata-only gap statically; number collision, placement and font geometry remain R07 actual-screen obligations.

Source Q01 figure f02 (Word p561-562) remains after Q01, and f01 (Word p572-573) remains before Q05 following Q04. Current first-unresolved-block/group prefix logic withholds both later figure/prose and new later holes until earlier holes resolve. Learner per-step views and old-complete resume agree with this ordering.

Proposed migration invokes actual LegacyUnit prior chains, archives prior revision/completion, preserves old item records and leaves six added N13 IDs missing. From a complete r4 save the first unresolved block is new Q04-positive. Retained out-of-order old future answers do not bypass earlier unresolved rows. This is static code/design evidence, not actual persisted browser verification.

Scoped font contract explicitly selects 18px formula rows/options and 1em KaTeX, with paragraph math inheriting paragraph font. No actual computed geometry was obtained; the browser installation/launch failed and actual DOM remains zero.
